migration.name: 20260804120000_add_route_decision_log_route_context
migration.backfill: none — the route was never captured on prior decisions, so it cannot be reconstructed. Existing rows stay NULL and the drift rollup reports them as unattributed rather than guessing an origin.

fields.reason: A portal route path such as "/customer/marketing" — application topology, not subject data. It identifies WHICH route-context entry declared the sensitivity a decision routed at, so a declared-vs-measured drift is attributable to the route rather than only to the agent that happened to be on that page (BI-CF3049E7). Carries no personal, customer, or employee data, and no payload content. Nullable: callers with no route (scheduled jobs, system tasks) write NULL.
